seo.title: Aqua Nera Amazon River Cruise, Peru | James Wild & Co
seo.description: Aqua Nera by Aqua Expeditions: 20 suites, 40 guests, 40 crew, a plunge pool and spa. Three, four and seven nights from Iquitos and Nauta into Pacaya-Samiria, with every fare.

tagline: Twenty suites, a plunge pool and the black water lagoons of the Peruvian Amazon.
answer: Aqua Nera is Aqua Expeditions' 20-suite river ship in the Peruvian Amazon, launched in 2021. She carries 40 guests with 40 crew and sails three, four and seven nights from Iquitos and Nauta into the Pacaya-Samiria National Reserve, with chef Pedro Miguel Schiaffino's menu on board. She suits couples and families who want the Amazon with a spa, a pool and twice-daily skiff excursions.
facts: 20 design suites of 320 sq ft; 640 sq ft interconnecting
overview: Aqua Nera takes her name from the black water lagoons of the Peruvian Amazon. Noor Design drew her 20 suites and her social spaces, with accents from the rubber boom era. She carries 40 guests with 40 crew and sails with her sister Aria Amazon.

Every suite has floor-to-ceiling windows, a sofa, a king or twin beds and a walk-in rain shower; 105 and 107, 106 and 108, 205 and 207, and 206 and 208 connect. The top deck holds a plunge pool, indoor and outdoor lounges, a games room and a screening room; there is also a gym and a spa. Naturalist guides lead small groups out by skiff twice a day.

pricesNote: Per person, cruise only, in US dollars, as Aqua Expeditions lists each departure in its booking system (read 13 Nov 2026), before any offer. Where a category shows no fare it is sold out or not sold on that date. Aqua's Early Bird, returning-guest and loyalty savings are applied when booking, so the fare you pay can be lower; we confirm it with Aqua before you commit. Aqua Nera's Early Bird saving is 20% on 2026 to 2028 departures, on Aqua's terms.
inclusions: Selected premium wines and beer, and non-alcoholic drinks
Group transfers on Aqua's recommended flights
faqs: How much does Aqua Nera cost?
Aqua lists three nights from about US$5,300 per person and seven nights from about US$12,800, by deck and date. Every departure is in the table on this page.
In Iquitos, Peru, where Aqua's crew meets the noon flight. Depending on the season and route the ship boards at Iquitos or at Nauta, about two hours away.
What is the difference between Aqua Nera and Aria Amazon?
Both are Aqua's, both sail the same reserve. Aqua Nera (2021) has 20 suites, a plunge pool, spa, gym and screening room; Aria Amazon has 16 suites and is a little smaller.
Aqua names pink river dolphins, sloths, monkeys, caiman, macaws and other birds; nothing is promised in the wild.
Roughly December to May the rivers are high and skiffs reach into the flooded forest; June to November the water drops and jungle trails open. Aqua sails both seasons with different routes.
All meals, selected wines and beer, two guided excursions a day, group transfers, the Pacaya-Samiria fee, laundry and Starlink internet.
